# Chatmode Definitions Index

This document provides a master index of all chatmodes available in the LightSpeed organization.

## Core Chatmodes

| Chatmode | Description | Location |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| code-quality-guru | Code review and quality analysis | `.github/chatmodes/code-quality-guru.chatmode.md` |
| devops-helper | DevOps and infrastructure support | `.github/chatmodes/devops-helper.chatmode.md` |
| ls-block-expert | WordPress block plugin development | `.github/chatmodes/ls-block-expert.chatmode.md` |

## How to Use

Chatmodes are configured in `.github/chatmodes/` and define specialized instruction sets for Claude when working on specific domains.
